lesson_1.title: Array Caching
lesson_1.task:
A dynamic programming cache system is generating sequence values using a Fibonacci-like recurrence.

System Requirement:
Construct an array where each index i follows:
arr[i] = arr[i-1] + arr[i-2]
starting from base values [0,1].

Behavior Rules:
- Initialize sequence with [0,1]
- Continue building until n-th index
- Maintain full sequence order

Output Requirement:
Return the complete generated array.

lesson_1.title: Cache Lookup
lesson_1.task:
A memoization retrieval engine is querying precomputed sequence values.

System Requirement:
Given a cached sequence and an index, retrieve the stored value if it exists.

Behavior Rules:
- If index exists in cache, return value at that index
- If cache is empty or index is invalid, return -1

Output Requirement:
Return integer value from cache or error indicator.

lesson_1.title: Top-Down Blueprint
lesson_1.task:
A recursive computation engine is executing Fibonacci using memoization (top-down DP).

System Requirement:
Compute Fibonacci numbers using recursion with cached subproblem results.

Behavior Rules:
- Use recursive decomposition
- Store computed values in cache
- Avoid recomputation of states

Output Requirement:
Return Fibonacci(n).

lesson_1.title: Bottom-Up Build
lesson_1.task:
A tabulation engine is constructing Fibonacci values iteratively.

System Requirement:
Build a DP array from base cases upward until n is reached.

Behavior Rules:
- Start from known base values
- Iteratively compute next states
- Store all intermediate values

Output Requirement:
Return full DP array.

lesson_1.title: Execution Comparison
lesson_1.task:
A performance analyzer compares naive recursion vs memoized recursion execution cost.

System Requirement:
Compare computational efficiency between naive and cached Fibonacci implementations.

Behavior Rules:
- Evaluate execution complexity difference
- Determine which method is more efficient

Output Requirement:
Return qualitative comparison result.

lesson_2.title: Naive Fibonacci
lesson_2.task:
A recursive computation system is executing Fibonacci without optimization.

System Requirement:
Compute Fibonacci using pure recursion without caching.

Behavior Rules:
- No memoization allowed
- Direct recursive breakdown only

Output Requirement:
Return Fibonacci(n).

lesson_2.title: Memoized Fibonacci
lesson_2.task:
A dynamic programming optimizer is reducing redundant recursive calls.

System Requirement:
Compute Fibonacci using memoization to store intermediate results.

Behavior Rules:
- Store computed states in cache
- Reuse stored results instead of recomputation

Output Requirement:
Return Fibonacci(n).

lesson_2.title: Tabulated Fibonacci
lesson_2.task:
A bottom-up dynamic programming system is constructing Fibonacci sequences iteratively.

System Requirement:
Build Fibonacci sequence using tabulation (iterative DP array).

Behavior Rules:
- Initialize base values
- Iteratively fill DP table

Output Requirement:
Return full Fibonacci array.

lesson_2.title: Space-Optimized Fibonacci
lesson_2.task:
A memory-efficient system is computing Fibonacci using constant space optimization.

System Requirement:
Compute Fibonacci using only two tracking variables.

Behavior Rules:
- Maintain only last two states
- Do not store full sequence

Output Requirement:
Return Fibonacci(n).

lesson_2.title: Sequence Generator
lesson_2.task:
A sequence generation engine is producing Fibonacci series outputs.

System Requirement:
Generate full Fibonacci sequence up to index n.

Behavior Rules:
- Start from [0,1]
- Extend sequence iteratively

Output Requirement:
Return full sequence array.

lesson_3.title: Knapsack Grid Init
lesson_3.task:
A dynamic programming grid is being initialized for knapsack computation.

System Requirement:
Create a 2D DP table initialized with zeros for given dimensions.

Behavior Rules:
- Create matrix of size n x m
- Fill all cells with 0

Output Requirement:
Return initialized matrix.

lesson_3.title: Include/Exclude Choice
lesson_3.task:
A decision optimization engine evaluates knapsack choices using include/exclude logic.

System Requirement:
Compute maximum value using binary decision (take or skip item).

Behavior Rules:
- Each item can be included or excluded
- Maximize total value under constraints

Output Requirement:
Return maximum achievable value.

lesson_3.title: Knapsack Matrix
lesson_3.task:
A full dynamic programming knapsack solver is computing optimal item selection.

System Requirement:
Build DP table to compute maximum value under weight constraint.

Behavior Rules:
- Use bottom-up DP table
- Evaluate include/exclude transitions

Output Requirement:
Return maximum knapsack value.

lesson_3.title: Traceback Items
lesson_3.task:
A DP reconstruction engine is identifying selected items from knapsack computation.

System Requirement:
Backtrack through DP decisions to determine chosen item indices.

Behavior Rules:
- Trace selected decisions from DP table
- Collect item indices in order of selection

Output Requirement:
Return list of selected indices.

lesson_3.title: Capacity Tracker
lesson_3.task:
A DP monitoring system tracks remaining capacity across computation stages.

System Requirement:
Track remaining capacity after each decision stage in DP computation.

Behavior Rules:
- Update capacity per iteration step
- Store all intermediate states

Output Requirement:
Return array of capacity values per step.

lesson_4.title: LCS Grid Init
lesson_4.task:
A dynamic programming system is initializing a Longest Common Subsequence matrix.

System Requirement:
Create a 2D matrix for LCS computation initialized with base values.

Behavior Rules:
- Matrix dimensions depend on string lengths
- Initialize all cells to 0

Output Requirement:
Return initialized LCS matrix.

lesson_4.title: Character Match Logic
lesson_4.task:
A DP transition system evaluates character matches for LCS computation.

System Requirement:
Compare two characters and compute DP transition value.

Behavior Rules:
- If characters match, return 1
- Otherwise return max(left, top) state

Output Requirement:
Return computed DP cell value.

lesson_4.title: Full LCS Table
lesson_4.task:
A DP system computes the length of the Longest Common Subsequence using a full matrix approach.

System Requirement:
Build LCS DP table and compute final LCS length.

Behavior Rules:
- Fill DP table bottom-up
- Use standard LCS recurrence relation

Output Requirement:
Return LCS length.

lesson_4.title: Reconstruct LCS String
lesson_4.task:
A reconstruction engine is rebuilding the actual Longest Common Subsequence from a computed DP table.

System Requirement:
Backtrack through DP matrix to construct LCS string.

Behavior Rules:
- Follow DP backtracking rules
- Build sequence in correct order

Output Requirement:
Return reconstructed LCS string.

lesson_4.title: Backtrack Steps
lesson_4.task:
A DP analyzer is measuring the number of steps taken during LCS backtracking.

System Requirement:
Simulate backtracking process and count total traversal steps.

Behavior Rules:
- Count every move during reconstruction
- Include diagonal, up, and left transitions

Output Requirement:
Return total step count.
